objects.name: Analytic 1817
objects.description: For iOS, detect Bidirectional Communication by correlating analyst-visible device/network evidence and management state; use streaming or batched telemetry only where the documented collector is deployed. Correlate Application Permission via Application Vetting [Code-signing entitlements and Info.plist privacy usage-description keys]; Application State via Apple MDM [InstalledApplicationList / ManagedApplicationList]; Network Traffic Content via Enterprise Secure Web Gateway / Proxy [DNS/HTTP(S) inspection or proxy transaction metadata where enterprise decryption/inspection is deployed]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.

x_mitre_mutable_elements.description: Apps approved for bidirectional use of each platform: note-taking app for its own cloud, email app for its service. Non-platform apps doing read-then-write cycles are anomalous.
Default 120s between inbound retrieval and outbound write constituting one C2 cycle. Tightening: 30s.
Default 3 retrieve-write cycles within $ObservationWindow$. Single cycle may be legitimate; repeated cycles are C2 pattern.
